evidence.snippet: This documentation site is itself an MCP server. Connect an agent to it and the agent can search these docs directly
that call the Marketing API itself.

decisions.reason: The vendor-hosted MCP server only exposes docs-search/fetch tools for the documentation site itself, not the Mailchimp Marketing API, so it does not qualify as an official API MCP server; no other vendor-published API MCP server is shown in the pages.
